items.text: AI is becoming a primary interface for product discovery, opening new revenue opportunities for retailers. See how NVIDIA is helping retailers prepare for agentic commerce, from product discovery to secure checkout, while maintaining control over pricing, payments and compliance.
R to @OpenAI: Audio moves through a dedicated fast path, while deeper reasoning and tool use happen asynchronously. We also reduced voice-session startup from six network round trips to one.

R to @OpenAI: The result is a faster, more natural conversation with ChatGPT Voice from the moment a session starts. How we built it: https://openai.com/index/continuous-voice-interaction-with-gpt-live/

GPT-Live can listen while it speaks. To make that feel natural at ChatGPT scale, we rebuilt the voice stack from client to model. This new architecture keeps audio flowing continuously, so deeper reasoning and tool use don't interrupt the conversation.

R to @OpenAI: We’re releasing the manuscripts, formal Lean certificates, and reasoning walkthroughs so mathematicians can examine these results and build on their ideas. https://openai.com/index/ten-advances-in-mathematics/

An internal version of our next major model produced 10 new results on long-standing open problems in mathematics and theoretical computer science, using roughly $2,000 worth of tokens at GPT-5.6 Sol API rates.

R to @OpenAI: The results span sphere packing, coding theory, group theory, quantum complexity, lattice cryptography, extremal combinatorics, and more. Among them: establishing the existence of non-sofic groups and exponential improvements to bounds on high dimensional sphere packing.

The funny thing about Anthropic and OpenAI people saying they want to slow down AI progress is that this is what Anti Trust mechanisms were built for. It's illegal to collude and slow down AI progress.

R to @karpathy: More on the pelican on the bicycle test from @simonw: https://simonwillison.net/2025/Jun/6/six-months-in-llms/ I uploaded the source here so it's playable in the browser, forkable etc. https://karpathy.ai/lotr-movie/ Look out for GTA Hobbiton dropping before GTA VI :)

We're starting to leave the territory where you'd test an LLM by e.g. "create an svg of pelican on a bicycle". As one idea to generalize it, I was interested what Opus 5 would do if I gave it the first paragraph of the Lord of the Rings, a 1M token budget (~$10) and asked for three js render of it.
